prompt: Subject: White dance dress in golden light Main Subject: The person is placed large in the center of the screen. A vertical full-body photograph of a woman in white costume standing on pointe shoes in a dark hall lined with old stone pillars, spreading the hem of a large thin cloth to the left and right with both hands. A column of golden light falling from behind illuminates the person and the dress. Person/Expression: Face directed toward the lower left, quietly looking at the spread cloth. Thin oval face, downcast elongated eyes, thin eyebrows, straight bridge of the nose, pale coral lips. Long light brown hair with thin bangs and loose waves, half tied back and flowing over the shoulders. Clothing/Pose: Ivory thin-strap corset costume with floral lace at the chest, central lacing, and sheer panels, with three-dimensional floral decorations wrapped around the upper arms. A very long thin multi-layered skirt spreads from the waist, showing the leotard part in the center. Both arms extended almost horizontally holding the edges of the hem, legs crossed and standing on the toes of both feet. Pale satin pointe shoes. Background/Light: Stone pillars on the left and right, dark wall in the background, with hard golden main light dropped from above. Thick classical stone pillars on both sides, dark decorative walls, stone floor. Golden light streams down from directly behind and above, shining through the fine dust in the air and the white cloth, dropping the surroundings into a deep brown. Composition/Camera: Focus on the person, full body within the frame, background naturally blurred. Person and dress shown large in the center. 3:4 vertical composition, full-body shot including the edges of the spread cloth and from pointe shoes to the head. Person placed strictly in the center, with pillars and light arranged almost symmetrically. Frontal shot from slightly below eye level. Texture/Style: Photorealistic live-action photo. Cinematic and ethereal realistic photo. High-definition depiction of sheer cloth, lace, satin, stone pillars, and dust in light using gold and ivory. Negative: Do not omit the long dance dress spread by both hands.

promptZh: 主体：金光中的白色舞裙 主要主体：人物位于画面中央，占据较大比例。这是一张垂直全身照，一位女性身着 白色舞裙，穿着足尖鞋站在排列着古老石柱的黑暗大厅中，双手向左右两侧展开宽大薄纱裙摆。一束从后方投射的金光照亮了人物和裙装。人物/表情：面部朝向左下方，静静地注视着展开的布料。瘦削的椭圆形脸庞，低垂的细长双眼，细眉，鼻梁挺直，淡珊瑚色嘴唇。浅棕色长发，留着薄刘海，波浪卷发自然垂落，半扎在脑后，流泻在肩头。服装/姿态：象牙色细肩带束身衣，胸前饰有花卉蕾丝，中间系带，带有透明拼接设计，上臂缠绕着立体花卉装饰。腰间散开极长的多层薄纱裙，中心露出紧身衣部分。双臂几乎水平伸展，握住裙摆边缘，双腿交叉，双脚踮起。淡色缎面足尖鞋。背景/光影：左右两侧为石柱，背景为暗墙，上方投下强烈的金色主光。两侧是厚重的古典石柱，装饰性的暗色墙壁，石质地面。金光从正后方上方倾泻而下，穿过空气中的微尘和白色布料，使周围环境沉浸在深棕色调中。构图/摄影：聚焦于人物，全身入镜，背景自然虚化。人物和裙装在画面中心呈现较大比例。3:4 垂直构图，全身镜头，包含展开的裙摆边缘，从足尖鞋到头部完整呈现。人物严格置于中心，石柱和光线呈对称排列。从略低于视平线的角度进行正面拍摄。质感/风格：照片级真实感实拍。电影感、空灵的写实照片。使用金色和象牙色，高画质呈现薄纱、蕾丝、缎面、石柱和光影中的微尘。负面提示：请勿省略双手展开的长舞裙。
